forecast-period.text: A high pressure system in the Bight extends a ridge over SA. The high moves through the Bight and over the eastern states, as a cold front clips the southeast on Friday. Another high pressure system moves over waters to the south of SA over the weekend, while a developing low pressure system and trough in WA move close to the SA border. The high drifts southeast of Australia as the low moves across SA on Monday.
For latest warnings go to www.bom.gov.au, subscribe to RSS feeds, call 1300 659 210* or listen for warnings on relevant TV and radio broadcasts.
* Calls to 1300 numbers cost around 27.5c incl. GST, higher from mobiles or public phones.

Possible morning fog patches about Eyre Peninsula. Showers about windward coasts, extending across the southern agricultural area during the afternoon and evening. Possible isolated showers or thunderstorms developing about the far west late. Maximum temperatures near to below average about central and eastern districts, grading to above average in the west. Southeast to northeasterly winds in the north, tending light winds in the south. Winds shifting north to northwesterly ahead of a fresh southwest to southeasterly change extending throughout during the afternoon and evening.

Possible light morning showers about the agricultural area. Possible showers or thunderstorms in the far west. Maximum temperatures below average, grading to above average in the northwest and far north. Moderate to fresh south to southeasterly winds, shifting east to northeasterly in the west.

Possible patchy frost about the southeast. Possible showers or thunderstorms in the west, extending into central districts during the day. Maximum temperatures below average, grading to above average in the west. Moderate to fresh southeast to northeasterly winds, shifting northwest to southwesterly in the far west.

text.p: Possible showers or thunderstorms about the pastoral districts and adjacent areas further south. Maximum temperatures above average. Moderate to fresh east to northeasterly winds, shifting southwest to southeasterly ahead of a trough moving across from the west during the day.

Cumulative rainfall totals to the end of Monday: Broadly less than 2 mm across the state. Falls increasing to 2 to 5 mm about the North West Pastoral and South East districts, with isolated falls of 5 to 10 mm possible about the far northwest and far southeast.
